The following vendors sell unlimited supplies of important ingredients.

* [[Deathroot (Origins)|Deathroot]]: [[Varathorn]] at the [[Dalish Camp]] (if you side with the werewolves he will be unavailable)
* [[Elfroot (Origins)|Elfroot]]: Varathorn at the Dalish Camp (if you side with the werewolves he will be unavailable)
* [[Deep Mushroom (Origins)|Deep Mushroom]]: [[Ruck]] in Ruck's Cave in the [[Ortan Thaig]] area of The Deep Roads (if you kill him his stock will be unavailable)
* [[Distillation Agent]]: Bartender in the Gnawed Noble Tavern in Denerim Market District and Bodahn Feddic at the Party Camp
* [[Flask]]s: [[Figor]] in [[Orzammar]] (cheapest), Bartender in the Gnawed Noble Tavern in Denerim Market District, and Bodahn Feddic at the Party Camp
* [[Lifestone]]: Ruck's Cave in the Ortan Thaig area of The Deep Roads (if you kill him his stock will be unavailable)
